en.kurz: The most important server settings by chat command, with SuperOP rights.
en.beschreibung: Admins change the most important server settings in chat. Every change is saved immediately and survives a restart. Some settings, such as creative and spectator mode, only the SuperOP may change.
funktionen: Settings: kreativ, zuschauer, abenteuer, schwierigkeit, pvp, inventar-behalten, feuer-ausbreitung, explosions-schaden, mob-griefing, monster-spawnen, phantome, wetterwechsel, zeit, reichweite, ein-spieler-schlaf, nether, end
Creative and spectator mode locked from the start, even for admins; only the SuperOP can unlock them
Range of 2 to 16 chunks around players and farm bots in which farms run
One sleeping player ends the night (important because farm bots never sleep)
Changes are announced in chat (can be turned off)
